text:
elaine: FYI customer ricardo reported rerank endpoint throwing 500s when input contains weird emoji sequences and C0 control chars. paste below.
ricardo: hitting this on prod, sample payload returns 500, same request works if I remove emoji. Logs show 'unicode replacement' in tokenizer.
elaine: can you paste request body? any null bytes?
ricardo: here's minimal repro (we redacted):
```json
{"query":"Find restaurants 😬\uDC00\uD83D\uDE00","candidates":["Place A","Place B\u0000","Place C"]}
```
elaine: notice the lone low surrogate \uDC00 in the query and an embedded null in candidate. server side shows 400→500 spike.
praveen: seeing similar in /rerank logs, stack:
```
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xC0 in position 12: invalid start byte
  File "rerank_service.py", line 214, in handle_request
    items = json.loads(payload)
  File "tokenizer.py", line 89, in encode
    raise TokenizationError('invalid utf-8')
```
praveen: root cause looks like ingest pipeline treats bytes as UTF-8 but some clients send CP1252-encoded strings or truncated surrogate pairs.
maria: we have sanitizer that strips \u0000 and replacement chars, but it only runs in hosted API path. Private/dedicated instances skip it? :thinking: 
elaine: customer is on Dedicated; they see the failure on dedicated nodes. migration to hosted temporarily fixes it.
maria: added a quick check: if payload contains NUL or lone surrogates, return 400 with helpful message instead of 500. PR incoming.
praveen: question: do we have consistent behavior across embeddings/ranking tokenizers? might affect rerank scoring if replacement char inserted.
elaine: customer also reports unexpected flat scores (all 0.5) when invalid sequences present. possible tokenizer produced no tokens -> default scoring.
praveen: repro script (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"query":"hi\xF0\x28\x8C\x28","candidates":["a","b"]}'
```
maria: stepping through tokenizer on this payload: invalid UTF-8 leads to empty token list, then ranking model returns uniform logits.
elaine: next actions:
- praveen: add defensive decoding + explicit 400 for bad-encoding (on dedicated and hosted)
- maria: patch sanitizer to run in private/dedicated path
- support: notify ricardo and offer quick workaround: strip problematic chars client-side or base64 encode input
elaine: ricardo can you try sending the same payload but base64-encoded in a field like `raw_b64`? we'll decode and run.
ricardo: trying now, will update in 5.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: fix/encoding-400 -> dedicated-prod (canary)
praveen: canary looks good, no 500s for injected null/surrogate tests. pushing to prod.
maria: opened ticket INF-842 to make sanitizer default everywhere + add unit tests for lone surrogates and NUL.
elaine: thanks everyone. ricardo, if you still see anything after we roll, reopen and we'll escalate.
ricardo: thanks, that fixed the immediate 500s. still seeing one case with weird mojibake where scores look off, will send sample.
elaine: closing for now but keeping INF-842 open until full rollout. :thumbsup:
